caseNameFull: Indian Protective Association v. Hugh H. Gordon and Benjamin Miller, Administrator
summary: Appeal from the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. Heber J. May, for Benjamin Miller, Administrator, one of the appellees, in support of the motion., Mr. Charles Poe, Mr. Daniel B. Henderson, Mr. Benjamin S. Minor and Mr. Hugh B. Rowland for appellants, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text: Decree affirmed with costs as to Benjamin Miller, Administrator.
